**L1 ACCEPT** at `9179aacd5b4d4d05e3ddbac2cec4f5ceb5b6c05d` (L1-a, build zone reviewer for the seat), with the seat's Clause-② review (TIER_DEFAULT, in-thread).

**Face.** `l1-face --pr 37932`: shape, `Fixes #37873`, changeset coverage (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`), declarations `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · `Metadata-protocol: none` all ok; dogfood and skills-docs not owed. CI at this head: 52 success · 10 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; `mergeable_state clean`.

**Head.** Reviewed in full at `417e56ea`; `a052f497` adds one docs-only commit (the `plugin-chatbot.mdx` and README snippet wrapped in a `PendingQuestion` component so it compiles on its own, `onAnswer={onSend}` / `onSkip={onDismiss}`), read line by line; `9179aacd5b` makes the typed row a `<label>` wrapping its input (`cursor-text`) instead of a `<div>` with a click handler that focused the input: the same behaviour, natively, and the input keeps its `aria-label`.

**Card #37873, item by item (read in `QuestionCard.tsx` and the two test files).**
1. Props in (`questions`), `onAnswer(text)` / `onSkip()` out. ✓
2. One question: a click sends the label at once (`sends the option label on a single click`). ✓
3. Two questions: Q1 advances, Q2 stops on Send with a one-line summary, Back keeps both choices (two tests). ✓
4. 「自己输入…」 last, one line, typing selects it and clears the option, Enter = next/send, blank text not sent. ✓
5. Answer text: label/typed for one; `header：answer` per line for two, question text when no header. ✓
6. Description as a grey second line, 「推荐」 badge. ✓
7. No forced focus; digits 1–4 / ↑↓ wrap / Ctrl·⌘+Enter only inside the card; IME composing ignored; radiogroup labelled by progress + question with a roving tab stop; `aria-live` polite gated by `announce` (Q2b triggers it). ✓
8. Card scrolls inside (`min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto`) above a `shrink-0` button row. ✓ (see nit N1)
9. All 11 locales carry the strings; `dir` follows the locale, Arabic RTL tested; zh-Hans tested string by string. ✓
10. Choices survive a re-render with new props (`keeps the picked option across a re-render…`). ✓
Acceptance test list (single-click send, two-question flow with back, typed answer, skip, keyboard, RTL, composition) is all present. `Fixes` is right: the card is the pure component only; wiring is Q2b #37874.

**Clause-② (widening).** The published surface grows by `QuestionCard` and three types, and every locale pack gains ten `chatbot.questionCard.*` keys; nothing existing is removed or narrowed. `QUESTION_CARD_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` stays off the barrel, and a test holds it byte-identical to `en`. The changeset's Clause-② line names exactly what the diff exports.

**Deviations judged.**
- `answerLine` (a tenth string not in item 9's list): accepted. Item 5 itself writes the separator as a full-width `：`, so a per-language separator is the faithful reading; the identity-test row records why en/ko/ru/ar keep `:`.
- Props typed locally: accepted. The local `QuestionCardQuestion` / `QuestionCardOption` match Q1 #37872's question element field for field (`header?`, `question`, `options[{label, description?, recommended?}]`; PR #37930 open). For Q2b #37874: keep the three exported names (alias them to the envelope types) so the swap stays non-breaking for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` consumers.

**Sentences read.** `.changeset/37873-question-card.md` and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` match the code sentence by sentence (one-click send, Send on the second question, typed row, focus never taken, keys only inside, re-render keeps choices, `key` remount, Arabic RTL).

**Nits (do not block).**
- N1: item 8 says about 60% of the input area; the card caps at `max-h-[60vh]`. A fair reading for the full-screen and drawer layouts, and `className` lets Q2b tighten it if the dock needs it.

**Body.** The "Local runs at 417e56ea" block names an older head and the old snippet; the thread patches it on this head (prose only, no record moves).
